label: Colostrum
comment: A second root beside milk: the first milkings after calving, a secretion of its own, which sets like egg when it is heated.

about.text: Colostrum, also called first milk, is the milk expressed by the mammary glands of a female mammal during the first few days following delivery of the newborn. Animal colostrum may be called beestings, the traditional word from Old English dialects.
